jobs.title: Hands-on Engineering Manager (C#/Vue)
jobs.description:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA + South America)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: €82,000–140,000; determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is looking for two Engineering Managers to lead two of our software development teams. We’re hiring for one existing team of 7 engineers and one new team that we will hire developers into.

This is a management role for someone who wants to grow as a manager while still remaining hands-on with code. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading your team and doing hands-on work alongside them.

About Miaplaza

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on

We’re a C# and Vue.js platform growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both product and engineering initiatives. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers.

How management works at Miaplaza

We're a US-based company, so this may differ from what you've done before:

  1. You start as an engineer. You’ll onboard as a senior engineer on your own team for two months, begin manager onboarding in month two, and take over the team at around week 10. Both phases matter equally, and this isn’t negotiable.

  2. You stay hands-on. Around 50% of your time stays hands-on after onboarding, but leading and supporting your engineers always comes first.

  3. You teach. Growing your engineers and those around you is a core responsibility. You'll have full oversight of your direct reports' work, because you can't teach well without seeing the process behind the output.

  4. Feedback is the norm. You'll give specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something, and you'll receive it too.


What you must bring

We can only move forward with candidates who meet these requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in software development in one or more object-oriented programming languages

  • 3+ years of experience with front-end software development in a reactive front-end framework

  • 3+ years of experience with software architecture

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader

  • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • Experience working directly with product and design on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience being on-call and resolving production incidents

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

What makes you stand out

  • Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

  • Experience with consumer platforms at scale

  • Experience building in regulated environments

  • Experience with DevOps technologies (eg K8s, IaC, sysadmin, build pipelines, etc.)

  • Extensive senior front-end development experience

Responsibilities

  • Work with your teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable web applications using primarily C# and Vue.js

  • Collaborate with your product trio (PM, UX, EM), product leadership team, and other EMs to scope, prioritize, and deliver features that matter to students and families

  • Set the quality bar for your team. You'll have dedicated capacity for reliability and architecture work rather than fitting it around feature delivery, and a strong say in where that capacity goes.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean architecture, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, so our process is longer than usual. At every stage we try to respect your time.

  1. Application and CV review. We review your application answers and CV, then follow up with an update.

  2. Initial technical screen (20 min). A few administrative questions and short technical questions related to the role.

  3. Behavioral interview (1 hour). With a member of our HR team, about your experience and approach so far.

  4. 1st technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to answer technical questions tailored to our work.

  5. 2nd technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to dive into a hypothetical scenario and how you’d tackle it.

  6. Leadership interview (1 hour). With our Head of Engineering or executive leadership.

  7. Reference check. We contact the 3 references you provide, including at least one former or current manager, a colleague, and a former or current direct report.

  8. Offer and background check. Once you sign your offer, we run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Our compensation philosophy aims for equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement in the range depends on demonstrated skills, internal equity and local labor market rates for your area.

Miaplaza is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

Du arbeitest an modernen Backend-Lösungen und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein.

Uns ist wichtiger wie wir zusammenarbeiten, als möglichst viele Buzzwords aufzuzählen.
Wir wissen: Gute Software entsteht in einem guten Team.

Wen wir suchen

Du musst nicht jedes Framework kennen. Wichtiger ist, dass du Lust hast, sauberen Code zu schreiben und gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Du passt wahrscheinlich gut zu uns wenn du:

  • mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung mit Java-Enterprise-Anwendungen und mit Spring, Spring Boot mitbringst,

  • du dein Wissen gerne mit anderen Kolleg:innen teilst und ggfs. neue Entwickler:innen einarbeiten möchtest,

  • Erfahrung beim Design und der Umsetzung von RESTful APIs sammeln konntest,

  • einen sicherer Umgang mit modernen Entwicklungswerkzeugen wie Git, Maven, SonarQube, Container hast,

  • du gerne im Team arbeitest und du Software nicht nur entwickeln, sondern auch verbessern möchtest,

  • komplexe fachliche und technische Themen verständlich erklären kannst,

  • selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert arbeitest,

  • gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und dich durch eine offene und empathische Kommunikation auszeichnest,

  • Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns besser zu werden,

  • über fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) verfügst.

Über uns

Bei uns gilt das Prinzip „voneinander, füreinander.“ Das ist kein Leitbild für die Wand, sondern die Art, wie wir zusammenarbeiten.

Du kannst bei uns Verantwortung übernehmen, Ideen einbringen und Dinge wirklich mitgestalten. Eigeninitiative und proaktives Handeln werden nicht nur erwartet, sondern gesehen und wertgeschätzt. Jede Person bringt ihre eigenen Stärken und Interessen ein und genau daraus entsteht unser gemeinsamer Erfolg.

Wir glauben daran, dass gute Beratung nur mit einem starken Team funktioniert. Deshalb sind unsere Türen jederzeit offen, wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig und teilen Wissen statt Konkurrenzdenken zu fördern. Neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen starten mit einem persönlichen Mentoring, das den Einstieg leicht macht und von Anfang an Sicherheit gibt.

Lern uns erst kennen.

Wir bieten dir ein unverbindliches Kaffee-Date.

Keine Verpflichtung, Einfach ein ehrliches Gespräch.

Jetzt bewerben

  • Design robust, reproducible, and extensible data pipelines to support model training, evaluation, and delivery.

  • Take AI research and experimentation through to production-ready solutions, collaborating with engineering and product teams to integrate models into Makersite's platform. 

  • Evaluate model performance and drive iterative improvements in accuracy, scalability, and practical application. 

Advance Makersite's AI Strategy 

  • Contribute to the evolution of Makersite's AI strategy, identifying opportunities to improve existing models, processes, and capabilities. 

  • Research emerging AI approaches and propose improvements to our AI stack and model development practices. 

Collaborate & Provide Technical Leadership 

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and other stakeholders to translate complex business challenges into AI-driven solutions. 

  • Share research findings and provide technical guidance, taking ownership of complex problems from exploration through to delivery. 


  • 7+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, AI research, or a related field. 

  • Research-oriented background in AI/ML, with demonstrable research contributions such as publications or technical papers. 

  • Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and optimising ML models and LLMs. 

  • Strong Python skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Pandas. 

  • Proven experience taking AI/ML solutions from research and experimentation through to production-level delivery. 

  • Strong understanding of data extraction, processing, and pipeline development for AI/ML model training. 

  • Manufacturing domain knowledge and experience working with complex B2B or enterprise datasets. 

  • Experience collaborating within AI/ML teams and with cross-functional stakeholders. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in Germany or the UK.

  • Experience developing customer-specific AI models and taking AI products or solutions to market. 

  • Experience contributing to AI strategy or the development of AI capabilities within an organisation. 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, manufacturing, or sustainability. 

Key Attributes 

  • Research-driven and naturally curious, with a passion for exploring and developing new AI approaches. 

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with complex, ambiguous challenges. 

  • Ownership-driven, entrepreneurial, and focused on delivering outcomes. 

  • Pragmatic, balancing research and innovation with business constraints and real-world application. 

  • Strong communicator and collaborator, able to share insights and work effectively across teams. 

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities. 

 

What We Offer:

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent).

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect.

jobs.title: Forward-Deployed CRM Architect
jobs.description:
RevOps is changing fast, and so is the way GTM processes get built and maintained inside the CRM. This role puts you on the front edge of it: forward-deployed in our clients' RevOps teams, building and running their GTM systems in a genuinely AI-first environment.

GTMBase is an AI-first GTM engineering and RevOps agency. We help post-PMF B2B companies (€8M to €50M ARR, 5+ reps) whose go-to-market is over-performing their systems. Reps do manually what should be automated, sales and marketing data doesn't connect, and leadership can't trust the reporting.

We combine strategic GTM thinking with hands-on technical build, and we fix the foundation before running campaigns.

We deliver across Four Pillars:

  1. Data Foundation: list building and enrichment so reps win with better data (Clay, Apollo, custom scrapers, AI research)
  2. RevOps & CRM: building the right GTM process inside the client's CRM, including architecture, lifecycle, pipelines, routing, and reporting (HubSpot, Salesforce)
  3. Agentic Workflows: building agentic GTM workflows with Anthropic Managed Agents and Hermes, getting the org ready for Agentic GTM
  4. GTM Strategy & Plays: recommending and executing the highest-impact campaigns

We've done this for clients including Groupon, Blinkist, Booksy, and Sendify. We work in small pods, with a Strategist, a CRM Architect, and a GTM Engineer.

How We Operate

We run the company on Claude Code. It's our operating system: client context, playbooks, automations, and delivery all live in it, and AI is the default way we work rather than a bolt-on. You'll work this way too, and get very good at it.

Why This Role Matters

You're the person who turns our GTM strategy into a CRM that actually works. Most clients run their entire revenue motion on HubSpot or Salesforce, and the quality of that system runs through this role: how clean the data is, how well leads route, whether leadership can trust the reporting.

Here, "Architect" means architecting inside the CRM: the object model, pipelines, workflows, and automations. The GTM and revenue strategy is set with you in your pod, not by you alone, and you build it with real craft.

You're forward-deployed: you embed with clients' RevOps and sales teams and build inside their live CRM.

The Role

You'll build and maintain GTM process and automation inside our clients' CRMs, mostly HubSpot. Working from the direction set in your pod, you turn requirements into a clean, well-built system the sales team can rely on.

One week you're building a client's lead lifecycle and routing. The next you're debugging a broken automation, untangling duplicate deals, or shipping a dashboard a CRO asked for. You move across several client instances at once without dropping threads.

You're a builder with an admin's discipline. You know the object model, not just the UI. You sweat the details others miss, you test before you ship, and you document what you build so the rest of the pod can run it. When something breaks, you find the root cause and fix it properly.

How This Differs From a GTM Engineer

Your pod is you (CRM Architect), a Strategist who sets direction and hands you requirements, and a GTM Engineer. You and the GTM Engineer are both builders, but you own different layers:

  • You (CRM Architect, Pillar 2): the GTM process inside the CRM. HubSpot/Salesforce architecture, lifecycle, routing, deal logic, automation, reporting, data integrity. You live in HubSpot, Salesforce, Operations Hub, and n8n.
  • GTM Engineer (Pillar 1): the data layer. Enrichment, scraping, signal detection, list building, custom research agents. They live in Clay, Apify, custom scrapers, and data APIs.

Think of it as the data into the CRM (GTM Engineer) versus the system it lands in and the process the sales team runs on (you). You don't need to be a Clay or Apify expert. You just need a solid working understanding of what a GTM Engineer does, enough to spec what you need, integrate their output cleanly, and know what's possible.

What You'll Do

  • Architect and build in client HubSpot instances: information architecture (objects, associations, lifecycle stages, pipeline structure), workflows, deal logic, lead scoring, routing, properties, and permissions
  • Build and debug automations across the GTM stack: HubSpot workflows, n8n, APIs, and webhooks. When an automation breaks, you find the root cause rather than just toggling features
  • Guard data integrity: deduplication, field validation, association hygiene, and import discipline so reporting and forecasting can be trusted
  • Build the reporting leadership relies on: pipeline coverage and velocity, stage-by-stage conversion, and full-funnel dashboards. You know where HubSpot's platform and paywall limits force a different approach
  • Design integrations and data flows between HubSpot and the rest of the stack (Clay, Aircall, telephony, billing, enrichment pipelines)
  • Turn requirements into working builds: take a brief like a 15-minute lead-response SLA and ship the routing system that delivers it
  • Keep multiple client instances healthy at once, with fast turnaround and nothing falling through the cracks
  • Work client-facing: you can talk through a data question with a technical lead and walk a frustrated AE through a new flow in the same afternoon
  • Codify what works into our library of reusable plays and patterns, so every client build sharpens the whole team

What We're Looking For

Must-have

  • Deep HubSpot expertise: hands-on across Sales, Marketing, Service, and Operations Hubs. You know HubSpot well enough to know what is and isn't possible at the platform level, and to choose native functionality over a workaround when it's the right call.
  • Strong CRM and RevOps fundamentals: lead lifecycle and qualification, routing and assignment, pipeline and deal-stage setup, the data model, and the governance that keeps it clean.
  • An admin's discipline: precise, reliable, and detail-obsessed. You test before you ship, you keep data clean, and you don't let things fall through the cracks.
  • A builder's instinct: you build workflows and integrations, debug them when they break, and aren't intimidated by APIs, webhooks, or a tool you haven't used yet.
  • AI-first, and we mean it literally: AI is your default operating mode, not a novelty. Your first move on a problem is to reach for an agent, a prompt, or a workflow before a manual process. If you're not already using AI tools daily, this isn't the right fit. (If your CRM fundamentals are deep but your GTM-tooling experience like Clay or Claude Code is light, that part is learnable and we'll back you on it. The fundamentals and the AI-first instinct are not.)
  • Forward-deployed temperament: comfortable building across multiple clients in parallel, client-facing, proactive, and able to move fast without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Full-time availability with reliable overlap to CET hours.

Nice-to-have

  • Salesforce: admin or build experience, especially HubSpot to Salesforce sync and migrations (relevant to Groupon and enterprise work)
  • A working understanding of the GTM Engineer's toolkit: Clay, Apify, enrichment providers (ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit), scraping. Enough to collaborate, spec, and integrate. Your pod's GTM Engineer owns the deep builds.
  • n8n orchestration and custom API integrations
  • Scripting (Python, SQL, or JavaScript) for data manipulation and custom connectors
  • German: a good chunk of our client base is DACH
  • HubSpot certifications: a plus, never a gate. Demonstrated depth matters more.

What You'll Get

  • Real client build work from day one, with no busy work and no hand-holding
  • A front-row seat in a genuinely AI-first environment: Claude Code as the operating system, Clay, and the full modern GTM stack
  • Direct collaboration with one of the most experienced RevOps leaders in Europe
  • Exposure to a wide range of B2B companies, stacks, and GTM problems
  • A seat at the table in a growing practice, not a cog in a machine
